<!-- pr-reviewer: 84605711c04cc90775792267e84d86e241b0d319 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Test-only change (3 files); no product code, no `Cargo.toml`/build.rs/.github/process files touched, so it was built.
- Both `CuttingRow` literals now use `CuttingRow::plain(Some(WorkMaterial::MildSteel), rpm, feed)` (`crates/tools/src/cutting_rows.rs:48`), which sets the current shape (`material: Option<WorkMaterial>`, `stepdown: None`, `stepover: None`, `waterjet: None`). The inputs are unchanged (rpm 0.0, feed 50.0 / 100.0), so the refusals still fire.
- No assertion weakened: the `wire_tool.rs` and `wire.rs` assertions are untouched ("EDM conditions", `!row.is_sane()`).
- `step_agreement.rs` adds a `fig8.step` row and its `step_fig8` per-file test, documented as the pinned reading (solidcore refuses on pcurves, truck reads it, mesh "no exact solid to judge against"), mirroring the `fillet_corner` row. This pins an observed behaviour, it does not loosen a check. Note: the cause of the solidcore pcurve refusal is not investigated here (stated in the PR body).

**Results** (trial merge of the head with upstream/main e808c9629; run locally on host dude, not the runner)
| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 147 passed (+3, +3 other targets) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wire_tool` | 5 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-tools --lib wire` | 1 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement` | 19 passed (incl. `step_fig8`) |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Windows-only/ui suites were not run here (nothing in the diff is per-OS); the post-merge gate covers them.
- PR is by the maintainer; a collaborator may merge it through `/merge-ready` once the maintainer's red-main fix is wanted (P2 #2244).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
